answer.reason: Joshua 8 and Judges 9 each tell an event that happened at the mountain.

clauses.english: was where half of Israel stood to bless the people after entering the land
clauses.quote: half of them over against mount Gerizim

clauses.english: was where Jotham stood and cried out to the men of Shechem
clauses.quote: he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim

doubts: JHN 4:20 says only "this mountain" and does not name Gerizim, so I left it out.
DEU 11:29 and DEU 27:12 are commands about the blessing, not events, so I cited only JOS 8:33, which says it was carried out.
